title: Intensive care, referral & transport
objectives: Set ventilator strategy for a postoperative neonate and state ECMO indications.
Write the transport checklist for a surgical neonate (warm chain, tube, access, documentation).
List what a neonatal SICU needs that an adult ICU does not.
body_md:
### Why this area matters

One full question per session on average covers SICU organisation, ventilation/ECMO, transport or nutrition access. It reads like administration but scores like protocol — lists with thresholds.

### Ventilation and ECMO

Neonatal lungs want low tidal volumes, adequate PEEP and permissive hypercapnia within limits; CDH and PPHN add pulmonary-hypertension-first management (oxygen, alkalosis within safe bounds, inhaled nitric oxide, then ECMO). ECMO indications: reversible respiratory or cardiac failure refractory to maximal therapy, with weight/gestation cutoffs, no major intracranial bleed, and a defined trial window — bridge to recovery, not destination therapy in neonates.

### The SICU and transport

A neonatal surgical ICU differs by warmer/incubator capacity, neonatal ventilators and circuits, parenteral nutrition compounding, and nursing ratios that assume total dependence. Organisation answers cover staffing, protocols, infection control and audit. Transport is a stabilise-then-move discipline: warm chain, secured airway with suction, two working IVs or IO, NG on drainage, glucose checked, monitors on, referral note with vitals trend, and a receiving team warned before wheels roll.

### Access and nutrition

Central access ladder: peripheral → ultrasound-guided → PICC → tunnelled line → implantable port, chosen by duration and osmolarity. Parenteral nutrition complications divide into line (sepsis, thrombosis), metabolic (cholestasis, bone disease, electrolyte shifts) and gut (atrophy, bacterial translocation) — enteral feeding, even trophic, protects against all three.

### How it is asked

Organisation questions want structure (staff, equipment, protocols, audit); clinical ones want thresholds and sequences. The transport checklist is a guaranteed sub-part somewhere.
